messages:
maria: Heads-up — Catalyst samplekit e2e failing in CI when running the eval harness with the LlamaIndex demo. Repro steps:
```
yarn test:e2e --grep "eval-harness"
```
Error looks like a mix of telemetry init timeouts and an auth refresh loop. Link: https://gist.github.com/example (logs)

omar: Can you paste the failing logs/stack?

maria: Logs:
```
Error: AuthError: token refresh failed (401)
    at Auth._refresh (/repo/node_modules/redwood-sdk/lib/auth.js:128:23)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
Caused by: TelemetryError: reporting timeout after 5000ms
```

jun: Is this happening against Hosted Redwood API or running the private dev proxy? Could be SDK parity drift between js/python auth helpers.

maria: Happening on CI (ubuntu-22), Node 18. We've got SDK js v0.12.1 and python wrapper 0.8.0 in different examples. Repro locally when running samplekit with envs: REDWOOD_API_KEY=... REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT=https://telemetry.redwood.example
Workaround that unblocks CI: export REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_BASE_MS=200

omar: Huh — our client should refresh tokens cleanly on 401. Might be the sample's auth helper re-tries without checking TTL and triggers a storm. I'll try to reproduce locally.

ci-bot: CI pipeline failed: catalyst-eval-e2e #452 on ubuntu-22 — https://ci.example.com/build/452 :rotating_light:

sergio: Can we get a patch before the onboarding workshop on Tue? This sample is used in the workshop.

jun: If it's in the scaffold, we should patch the sample and add a tiny smoke test that exercises auth rotation. Proposal:
```
# samples/catalyst/test/auth-rotation.spec.js
it('rotates token without 5xx', async () => {
  // simulate short TTL, call sample endpoint twice
});
```

omar: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalyst-samples/pull/789 — adds TTL check in the sample auth helper, adds retry jitter, and a smoke test. Also added a note to the sample README about env var overrides. :thumbsup:

maria: Rerunning CI now.

maria: CI is green on main after PR merge — marking this resolved. Please add a quick blurb to the onboarding guide about SDK env var differences for local dev (< 5 line note). @sergio

sergio: Will do, I'll add doc note and ping growth to update the workshop slides. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
